note: General wellness ideas only. India-first. diet = the strictest diet that still fits: vegan < vegetarian (dairy) < egg.

items.name: Water
items.note: Sip before, during and after a walk. Carry a bottle.

items.name: Coconut water (nariyal pani)
items.note: A refreshing, naturally lightly salty drink after a warm walk.

items.name: Nimbu pani with a pinch of salt
items.note: A simple salty-sweet drink for hot, sweaty days. Skip the extra salt if you have been told to limit it.

items.name: Buttermilk (chaas)
items.note: Cooling and a little salty. Good on hot days.

items.name: Lightly salted water with a squeeze of lemon
items.note: For very hot, long walks. Take small sips.

items.name: Banana
items.note: Easy to carry, gentle on the stomach.

items.name: Seasonal fruit (guava, papaya, orange, apple)
items.note: Whatever is fresh near you.

items.name: A handful of roasted peanuts
items.note: Crunchy and filling. Skip if you have a nut allergy.

items.name: Roasted chana
items.note: A light, protein-rich crunchy snack.

items.name: Almonds and a date or two
items.note: Pocket-friendly option for longer walks.

items.name: Sprouts chaat with lemon
items.note: Fresh, protein and fibre together.

items.name: Boiled chana salad
items.note: A simple pairing of protein and complex carbs.

items.name: Poha with peanuts and vegetables
items.note: A light breakfast after a morning walk.

items.name: Vegetable upma
items.note: Warm and easy to digest.

items.name: Idli with sambar
items.note: Lentils plus rice make a balanced, light meal.

items.name: Dal, rice and a vegetable
items.note: A classic balanced plate after a longer or brisker walk.

items.name: Curd or a glass of lassi
items.note: Protein and probiotics; go lighter on sugar.

items.name: Paneer bhurji with a roti
items.note: Protein with whole grains.

items.name: Moong dal chilla
items.note: Protein-rich and light.

items.name: Boiled eggs with fruit or toast
items.note: Quick protein after a brisk walk.

items.name: Egg bhurji with a roti
items.note: A familiar, filling post-walk plate.

items.name: Fruit with a bowl of curd
items.note: Cooling and simple.
